entities.summary: Óscar Hernández Pérez is a former professional male tennis player from Spain. He turned pro in 1998 and achieved his career-high singles ranking of World No. 48 in October 2007. Hernández scored an upset in the first round of the 2007 Rome Masters, when he defeated the World No. 20, Lleyton Hewitt, 3–6, 7–6(3), 6–1. Hernández announced his retirement from tennis on 22 July 2011. Óscar Hernández was a athletes & competitors from Barcelona (b. 1978-04-10, Barcelona). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
